preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The length of the string s is between 2 and 10^6, inclusive.
The string s consists only of characters 'a', 'b', and 'c'.

postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 or a length of a substring that satisfies the conditions.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or (count('a') > count('b') and count('a') > count('c')) for substring of s of length output[i])
postconditions.description: For each valid output, the substring has 'a' occur strictly more times than 'b' and 'c' in the substring.
For each valid output, the length of the substring is at least 2.
